decks.notes: This deck focuses on locking down the opponent's board with disruptive spells like The One Ring and Prismatic Ending, while also controlling the game with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding. Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and Fury can deal with small threats. Elesh Norn and Omnath are powerful win conditions, with Nissa helping to ramp up mana. Solitude provides removal, while Delighted Halfling offers additional creature support. The mana base is versatile, allowing for easy access to different colors of mana for the deck's various spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes spells like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Prismari Command to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. This deck focuses on quick and aggressive gameplay, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply early pressure. It disrupts opponents' strategies by using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer, Grief, and Thoughtseize to strip their hand of resources. It includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. The deck also has recursion abilities with cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice, allowing it to bring back creatures from the graveyard. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while providing additional utility with cards like Castle Locthwain.

This UR Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, backed up by disruptive spells like Unholy Heat and Counterspell. The deck also utilizes efficient card draw and selection with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain pressure. The inclusion of cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ledger Shredder further enhances the deck's aggression and versatility. With a focus on quick, aggressive plays and disruption, the deck aims to control the board and finish off the opponent swiftly.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with strong enter-the-battlefield effects and sacrificing them to generate value and combo off. By tutoring for specific creatures with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can assemble different creature combinations to generate incremental advantage and potentially win the game on the spot. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in adapting to different matchups and situations, while also providing consistent and powerful synergy between the creatures included in the deck.

The deck focuses on aggressively reducing your own life total to power up Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent, while disrupting your opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes control elements like Counterspell and Drown in the Loch to protect your threats. Overall, the key idea is to apply pressure early while disrupting the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

The key concept of this deck revolves around cycling through cards to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden onslaught of powerful creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Grief and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan while executing its own combo. The synergy between creatures with cycling abilities and Living End creates a fast and explosive win condition, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deploy threat creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game, securing victory through a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

This deck aims to control the game by using cards that limit the opponent's options and disrupt their strategy. This Modern deck focuses on controlling the board and manipulating resources to gain an advantage over the opponent.
